title: L.L.Bean Recalls Knife with Sheath Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The knife blade can cut through the protective leather sheath, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 600.

title: BRP Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The dynamic power steering shaft can break and result in a loss of steering control, posing a crash hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,500 (In addition, about 2,800 in Canada).

title: Mizco International Recalls Power Bank Charging Stations Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold at The Container Store
summary: When the unit is being charged, it can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 6,000.

title: Spirit Halloween Recalls Nickelodeon PAW PATROL Marshall Hat with Flashlight Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The batteries in the flashlight can overheat, causing the flashlight to become hot, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 20,000 (In addition, about 1,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Vornado Air Recalls Electric Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The electric space heater can overheat when in use, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 350,000.

title: Scotch Thermal Laminators Recalled by 3M Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The plastic enclosure can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 395,000 (In addition, about 130 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls RZR XP 1000 Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Fire Hazard
summary: If the exhaust silencer fatigues and cracks, the heat shield may not manage heat, which may lead to melting of nearby components or fire. Units: About 107,000.

title: HD Supply Recalls Ceiling Fans Due to Impact Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The brackets connected to the fan blades can break and allow the blades to fall, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 144,000.

title: Honeywell Recalls Hard Hats Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The hard hats can fail to protect users from impact, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 82,500 (in addition, about 65,550 were sold in Canada).

title: Briggs & Stratton Recalls Surface Cleaners Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The surface cleaner's spray bar can break and detach from the central hub, causing broken pieces to strike consumers, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 201,000 (In addition, about 5,400 in Canada).

title: Base Brands Recalls Water Bottles Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pink paint on the outside of the bear water bottle contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint standard. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 2,000.

title: Polaris Recalls Phoenix 200 All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The throttle limiter can fail due to damage during shipping, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 5,600.

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger XP Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The center seat belt bracket can separate from the frame, posing an injury hazard to the riders. Units: About 10,900.

title: Wild & Wolf Recalls Petit Collage Children's Toy Xylophones Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The ball on the end of the toy xylophone beater stick can separate, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,900 (In addition, about 240 were sold in Canada).

title: Primark Recalls Decorative Cushions Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The cushions can catch fire if exposed to an ignition source, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 14,500.

title: Jo-Ann Stores Recalls Light Sets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The light set's glass jars can break during normal use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: Schneider Electric Recalls Square D Safety Switches Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The power can stay on when the safety switch handle is in the "OFF" position, posing an electrical shock or electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,079,000.

title: Group Rossignol Recalls LOOK Pivot Ski Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The heel piece on the ski binding can come loose, posing a fall hazard to the skier. Units: About 6,900 (In addition, 590 were sold in Canada).
